title: dedicated: autoscaling burst controls, utilization reporting, and throughput guarantees
author: Amira Khan
release_notes: Add burst control knobs for Dedicated autoscaler; emit per-fleet utilization and provisioned-throughput metrics; introduce throughput_guarantee config and rollout plan. No breaking API changes.
description:
Motivation: Customers using Dedicated capacity have asked for tighter controls around short-term bursts and clearer observability around provisioned throughput vs actual utilization. This PR implements three related pieces: 1) burst controls: max_burst_tokens and burst_window_ms to limit short-lived token spikes at the autoscaler level; 2) utilization reporting: new per-fleet metrics (fleet.provisioned_tps, fleet.avg_utilization_1m, fleet.peaks_5m) emitted to telemetry and surfaced in the Console; 3) throughput guarantees: a configuration option that reserves a baseline throughput for a customer with dynamic headroom rules.

Summary of changes: consolidated autoscaler policy evaluation into services/dedicated-autoscaler/policy.go and introduced a BurstController that applies an exponential decay window to recent token usage. Added new config fields to the dedicated capacity schema and validation logic in api/dedicated/config_validation.go. Emitted metrics via telemetry/metrics.go and added Grafana dashboard JSON updates under observability/dashboards/dedicated_utilization.json. Console: new UI panels (Console repo submodule update) to show provisioned vs observed throughput and recent burst events.

Checklist: 
- [x] Add burst control core logic and unit tests
- [x] Add telemetry hooks and metrics tests
- [x] Console UI changes (follow-up submodule bump)
- [x] Docs update (docs/operating/dedicated-autoscaling.md)
- [x] Integration test in perf-canary to validate behavior under synthetic spike
- [x] Canary rollout plan prepared

Testing and results: unit tests added (autoscaler + metrics). Perf canary run 2025-11-20 shows 35% reduction in sustained throttling during synthetic 60s spike and bounded latency increase; no regressions in steady-state throughput. CI runs flakily on one lint job initially - rerun passed.

Rollout plan: merge behind feature flag dedicated.autoscaler_burst_controls = off by default. Enable for internal Dedicated tenants for 1 week, monitor fleet.avg_utilization_1m and error rates, then enable for canary customers, then GA. If utilization drops below expected SLO, autoscaler will automatically fall back to previous policy (implemented).

Related: ENG-4521 implements the monitoring dashboards; ENG-4599 is the product workstream for throughput guarantees. Support ticket SUP-1186 requested clearer metrics for customers experiencing token storms.
